title: Valuation of Goodwill and Share in Profit (Continued)
title_hi: ख्याति का मूल्यांकन और लाभ में हिस्सा (जारी)
question: Calculate the valuation of goodwill, distribution of goodwill, and O's share in loss based on the previous data.
question_hi: पिछले डेटा के आधार पर ख्याति का मूल्यांकन, ख्याति का वितरण, और नुकसान में O के हिस्से की गणना करें।
question_gu: અગાઉના ડેટાના આધારે પાઘડીનું મૂલ્યાંકન, પાઘડીની વહેંચણી અને નુકસાનમાં O ના ભાગની ગણતરી કરો.
steps:
(2) Valuation of goodwill:
5 years average profit = 2,00,000 / 5 = 40,000
Goodwill = 40,000 × 3 = 1,20,000

(3) Distribution of goodwill:
Share of O in goodwill = 1,20,000 × 2/5 = 48,000
Gaining ratio of M and N:
Gain = New share - Old share
M = 1/2 - 2/5 = 1/10
N = 1/2 - 2/5 = 1/10
Gaining ratio of M and N = 1:1
Goodwill is to be given by M and N to O in equal proportion.

Journal Entry:
M's capital A/c...Dr 24,000
N's capital A/c...Dr 24,000
To O's capital A/c 48,000

(4) O's share in profit:
O died on 1-12-2016, so O will receive his share in profit from 1-4-2016 to 1-12-2016 i.e. for 8 months.
Last year 2015-16, the amount of loss is ₹ 60,000.
O's share in loss = 60,000 × 8/12 × 2/5 = 16,000
steps_hi:
(3) ख्याति का वितरण:
ख्याति में O का हिस्सा = 1,20,000 × 2/5 = 48,000
M और N का लाभ अनुपात:
लाभ = नया हिस्सा - पुराना हिस्सा
M = 1/2 - 2/5 = 1/10
N = 1/2 - 2/5 = 1/10
M और N का लाभ अनुपात = 1:1
ख्याति M और N द्वारा O को समान अनुपात में दी जाएगी।
steps_gu:
(3) પાઘડીની વહેંચણી:
પાઘડીમાં O નો ભાગ = 1,20,000 × 2/5 = 48,000
M અને N નું લાભનું પ્રમાણ:
લાભ = નવો ભાગ - જૂનો ભાગ
M = 1/2 - 2/5 = 1/10
N = 1/2 - 2/5 = 1/10
M અને N નું લાભનું પ્રમાણ = 1:1
પાઘડી M અને N દ્વારા O ને સમાન પ્રમાણમાં આપવામાં આવશે.

title: Illustration 27
question:
A, B and C are the partners sharing profit and loss in the ratio of 3:2:1. The balance sheet of the firm as on 31-3-2016 was as under :

| Liabilities | Amt. (₹) | Assets | Amt. (₹) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Creditors | 10,000 | Goodwill | 30,000 |
| Partners' loan : | | Patents | 25,000 |
| A | 12,000 | Building | 80,000 |
| B | 20,000 | Furniture | 60,000 |
| General reserve | 18,000 | Stock | 50,000 |
| Capital Accounts : | | Debtors | 60,000 |
| A | 90,000 | Cash | 15,000 |
| B | 90,000 | | |
| C | 80,000 | | |
| **Total** | **3,20,000** | **Total** | **3,20,000** |

B died on 30-6-2016. Under the partnership agreement, the executor of B is entitled to receive following :
1) Interest on his capital at 10 % p.a.
2) Share in general reserve.
3) His loan and outstanding interest on loan.
4) Value of goodwill is decided at ₹ 30,000.
5) Share of profit upto the date of death on the basis of last year's sales and profit. Sales for the year 2015-16 was ₹ 12,00,000. First three months sales of current year was ₹ 4,50,000. Net profit for the year 2015-16 was ₹ 2,40,000.
6) Patents are to be written off fully. Building is to be appreciated by 20 %.
Prepare the balance sheet as on 30-6-2016 after the death of B.
steps:
Calculations:
(3) Interest on capital to B from 1-4-2016 to 30-6-2016 = 3 months
= 90,000 × 10/100 × 3/12 = ₹ 2,250
(4) Outstanding interest on loan to B for 3 months at 6 % p.a. (As not stated in the partnership deed)
= 20,000 × 6/100 × 3/12 = ₹ 300
(5) Distribution of goodwill and share of B in goodwill
Old ratio of A, B and C = 3:2:1
B died; gaining ratio of A and C = 3:1
Share of B in goodwill = 2/6 × 30,000 = ₹ 10,000
Which will be given by A and C in the ratio of 3:1.
Journal Entry :
A's capital A/c...Dr 7,500
C's capital A/c...Dr 2,500
To B's capital A/c 10,000

(6) B's share in the profit of the firm from 1-4-2016 to 30-6-2016 means 3 month's profit
If sales of 2015-16 ₹ 12,00,000 : Net profit = 2,40,000
3 months sales of 2016-17 ₹ 4,50,000 : (?)
(2,40,000 × 4,50,000) / 12,00,000 = ₹ 90,000 (Three month's profit of the firm)
B's share in profit = 90,000 × 2/6 = ₹ 30,000
Note : B's share in profit, interest on capital and interest on loan should be transferred to profit and loss suspense account and it is shown on assets side of balance sheet.
Interest on capital = 2,250
+ Interest on loan ₹ 300
+ Share in profit ₹ 30,000
= ₹ 32,550
steps_hi:
गणना:
(3) B को 1-4-2016 से 30-6-2016 तक पूंजी पर ब्याज = 3 महीने
= 90,000 × 10/100 × 3/12 = ₹ 2,250
(4) B को 3 महीने के लिए 6% प्रति वर्ष की दर से ऋण पर बकाया ब्याज (चूंकि साझेदारी विलेख में नहीं बताया गया है)
= 20,000 × 6/100 × 3/12 = ₹ 300
(5) ख्याति का वितरण और ख्याति में B का हिस्सा
A, B और C का पुराना अनुपात = 3:2:1
B की मृत्यु हुई; A और C का लाभ अनुपात = 3:1
ख्याति में B का हिस्सा = 2/6 × 30,000 = ₹ 10,000
जो A और C द्वारा 3:1 के अनुपात में दिया जाएगा।
जर्नल प्रविष्टि:
A का पूंजी खाता...Dr 7,500
C का पूंजी खाता...Dr 2,500
B के पूंजी खाते से 10,000

| A's loan | 12,000 | Furniture | 60,000 |

| Capital Accounts : | | Debtors | 60,000 |
| A | 72,000 | Cash | 15,000 |
| C | 74,000 | Profit and loss suspense A/c (30,000 profit + 2250 Int. on cap + 300 int. on loan) | 32,550 |
